summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK Regulatory News Service announcement dated 2 November 2026, a routine notification of a PDMR share transaction (the US equivalent of a Form 4 insider filing). Non-Executive Director Danuta Gray acquired 41,375 ordinary shares of 10 pence each on 30 October 2026 at an average price of 95.7362 pence, executed on the London Stock Exchange across two tranches. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed. This is an ordinary insider-dealing disclosure with no special-situation or risk-arb implications.
